title: 17 States Haven’t Had a Woman Governor, and 15 Haven’t Had a Woman Senator
summary_en: Today, women currently hold a record 27 of the Senate’s 100 seats, and women hold the office of governor in 14 of the 50 states.
title_cn: 17 States Haven’t Had a Woman Governor, and 15 Haven’t Had a Woman Senator

title: Most Americans’ Religious Lives Haven’t Changed Much in Recent Years
summary_en: Tracking the same adults from 2020 to 2025 shows most Americans’ religious affiliation, prayer frequency and service attendance remained steady.
title_cn: Most Americans’ Religious Lives Haven’t Changed Much in Recent Years

title: Religion Remains Stable in the U.S., With Mixed Signals for Young Adults
summary_en: There is no clear evidence in the Center’s surveys that any birth cohort that can be tracked over time has become more religious in recent years.
title_cn: Religion Remains Stable in the U.S., With Mixed Signals for Young Adults
